📢 Carent Shop Affiliate Program – Join & Earn!

🔹 Brand Introduction:

Welcome to CARENTShop, home of ROUTINO – the interactive routine board that transforms daily habits into a fun learning experience for children. Our mission is simple: help parents create stress-free routines while encouraging children’s independence and development through play.

We specialize in eco-friendly, screen-free educational tools that make bedtime, mornings, cleanup, and school prep effortless for families. Now, we’re inviting passionate creators, educators, and parenting advocates to partner with us and share the benefits of ROUTINO with their audience!

🛍️ Product Description:

Our flagship product, ROUTINO, is a play-based learning tool designed for children ages 2-9 to master their daily routines. Each board features:

✅ Interactive sliders that engage kids in hands-on learning

✅ Step-by-step visuals to reinforce good habits

✅ A reward-based system that boosts motivation

✅ Durable, eco-friendly materials (zero plastic waste!)

✅ A scientifically-backed method for building independence

Parents love ROUTINO because it reduces daily battles, builds consistency, and encourages self-discipline—without nagging!

Product Variants:

🛏️ Bedtime ROUTINO – Helps kids wind down & get ready for sleep

🌞 Morning ROUTINO – Transforms chaotic mornings into smooth starts

🎒 Go-to-School ROUTINO – Ensures nothing is forgotten before heading out

🧹 Cleanup ROUTINO – Turns tidying up into a fun mission

✨ Highly Niche & In-Demand – Parents are constantly looking for ways to improve their child’s routine & behavior

🌱 Eco-Friendly & Screen-Free – A standout choice for conscious parents

🛒 Strong Conversion Rate – Parents love ROUTINO once they see it in action!

We want to reward our affiliates generously for helping us spread the word!

⏳ Cookie Duration: 30-day tracking period – if someone clicks your link and buys within 30 days, you earn a commission!

🚀 Bonuses: Top-performing affiliates may receive higher commission rates, exclusive discounts, and early access to new products!
